items.situation: student asking about gym or sports facility hours
items.speaker: How late is the fitness center open tonight?

options.A: Actually, it closes early on Fridays.
options.B: The new treadmills arrived last week.
options.C: I left my keys in the car.
options.D: Yes, you can bring a guest.

items.explanation: 对方问健身房今晚开到几点。正确答 A 先用 Actually 这个话语标记，再间接给出关键信息——周五提前关门（marker_led_indirect），比直接报一个时间更自然。B 抓住 fitness center 转去说新跑步机到货，只借语境不回答问题（语义联想陷阱）。C 说钥匙落在车里，与提问毫无关系（离题）。D 用 Yes 回答，可问的是「开到几点」不是「能不能」，答非所问（问题类型错位）。

items.situation: expressing concern about a friend's whereabouts
items.speaker: Where did Daniel disappear to after class?

options.A: He disappeared from the roster last term.
options.B: Your guess is as good as mine.
options.D: I finally returned that library book.

items.explanation: 对方问 Daniel 下课后跑哪去了。正确答 B 用地道口语「Your guess is as good as mine」表示「我也不知道」（idiomatic），是最自然的回应。A 把 disappear 换个意思说他上学期从名单上消失了，只借词不答题（语义联想陷阱）。C 回答的是时间，可人家问的是地点（问题类型错位）。D 说终于还了图书馆的书，完全跑题（离题）。

items.situation: student checking lost-and-found at front desk
items.speaker: I think I left my umbrella here yesterday.

options.A: It's supposed to rain all weekend.
options.B: No, I haven't seen that movie.
options.C: Well, let's check the lost-and-found bin.
options.D: Yes, the desk closes at six.

items.explanation: 对方说自己昨天可能把伞落在这儿了。正确答 C 用 Well 起头再提出去失物箱找找（marker_led_indirect），既回应又推进对话。A 抓住 umbrella 联想到天气，说周末都下雨，没解决问题（语义联想陷阱）。B 说没看过那部电影，与伞毫无关系（离题）。D 用 Yes 报出前台关门时间，对方并没有问时间（问题类型错位）。

items.situation: student checking bus or shuttle schedule
items.speaker: What time does the last shuttle leave campus?

options.A: The shuttle was pretty crowded this morning.
options.B: It stops right outside the science building.
options.C: I usually walk home after practice.
options.D: Eleven thirty from the main gate.

items.explanation: 对方问末班校车几点发。正确答 D 直接给出时间和发车点（direct_topical），信息到位。A 抓住 shuttle 说早上车很挤，只借词不答题（语义联想陷阱）。B 回答的是停靠地点，问的却是时间（问题类型错位）。C 说自己通常走回家，是个人习惯，没有回答问题（离题）。

items.situation: two classmates discussing a group project deadline
items.speaker: Do you think we can finish the slides tonight?

options.B: The slides are in the shared folder.
options.C: Yes, I finished my own presentation.

items.explanation: 同伴问今晚能不能把小组幻灯片做完。正确答 A 用口语说法「Not a chance」直截了当表示做不完（idiomatic），语气自然。B 抓住 slides 说文件在共享文件夹里，只谈位置不回答能否完成（语义联想陷阱）。C 把「我们的小组任务」误当成「我自己的展示」，理解错了对象（误解）。D 说周二更方便，答的是约时间而不是今晚能否完成（离题）。

items.situation: two friends deciding where to get lunch
items.speaker: Why is the dining hall so packed today?

options.A: The dining hall opened three years ago.
options.B: Beats me, I'd try the cafe instead.

items.explanation: 朋友问食堂今天怎么这么挤。正确答 B 用口语「Beats me」表示不清楚原因，再顺势建议改去咖啡馆（idiomatic），既回应又推进。A 抓住 dining hall 说它三年前开的，只借词不答原因（语义联想陷阱）。C 回答的是时间，问的却是原因（问题类型错位）。D 说自己退了化学课，与吃饭毫无关系（离题）。

items.situation: student seeking help at the writing center
items.speaker: Can someone look at my thesis paragraph today?

options.A: The writing center moved to the library.
options.B: Yes, I read that paragraph twice.
options.C: I'll take you to the front desk.
options.D: My thesis is due in April.

items.explanation: 学生问今天有没有人能看一下自己的论文段落。正确答 C 不纠结「能不能」，而是直接带他去前台安排（context_shift），解决了真正的需求。A 抓住 writing center 说它搬到图书馆了，只给背景信息不解决问题（语义联想陷阱）。B 说自己读过那段两遍，把「帮我看」误当成「你读过吗」（误解）。D 说自己的论文四月截止，讲的是自己的事（离题）。

items.situation: student asking about exam format or study materials
items.speaker: I still don't know what's on the midterm.

options.A: The midterm counts for thirty percent.
options.B: I know a few people in that class.
options.C: The bookstore ran out of notebooks.
options.D: Just check the review sheet she posted.

items.explanation: 对方说还不清楚期中考什么。正确答 D 用 Just 起头给出一个简短可行的办法——去看老师发的复习提纲（marker_led_indirect）。A 抓住 midterm 说它占三成分数，答的是权重不是内容（语义联想陷阱）。B 把 know 理解成「认识人」，用错了词义（误解）。C 说书店笔记本卖光了，与考试内容无关（离题）。

items.situation: responding to an invitation or suggestion
items.speaker: How do you feel about the concert Saturday?

options.A: The concert hall was renovated last spring.
options.B: I feel much better today, thanks.
options.D: My cousin plays the violin well.

items.explanation: 对方在试探你想不想去周六的音乐会。正确答 C 用一个反问把对话往前推——先问还有没有票（counter_question），既表达兴趣又推进安排。A 抓住 concert 说音乐厅去年春天翻修过，只借词不回应邀请（语义联想陷阱）。B 把 feel about 误当成问身体状况（误解）。D 说表哥小提琴拉得好，与去不去无关（离题）。

items.situation: student who missed a lecture asking a classmate
items.speaker: What did I miss in Tuesday's lecture?

options.A: Tuesday's lecture hall was almost full.
options.C: I dropped my umbrella in the hall.
options.D: I'll email you my notes tonight.

items.explanation: 同学问自己周二的课错过了什么。正确答 D 不去复述内容，而是直接说今晚把笔记发过去（context_shift），解决了对方真正的需求。A 抓住 lecture 说教室几乎坐满，只讲场面不讲内容（语义联想陷阱）。B 回答的是时长，问的却是内容（问题类型错位）。C 说自己把伞落在走廊，与提问无关（离题）。
